items.title: Nvidia reportedly in talks to finance OpenAI's massive Ohio data center
items.summary: Chipmaker Nvidia (NVDA) is reportedly in talks with OpenAI (OPAI.PVT) to help fund a $250 billion backstop, according to the Wall Street Journal, that would guarantee the latter's plans for an AI data center in Ohio. Yahoo Finance Tech Editor Dan Howley touches on the investor concerns this possible partnership could signal about circular investing in the AI landscape.
